name: Elite Pro English Willow Bat
tagline: Explosive pickup with a huge mid-to-low sweet spot.
shortDescription: Grade 1 English willow bat built for aggressive stroke play.
description: The Elite Pro is crafted from hand-selected Grade 1 English willow with a full profile, generous edges, and a balanced pickup that feels fast through the hands. It is designed for club and academy players who want crisp rebound, controlled pickup, and a premium finish.

name: PowerDrive Kashmir Willow Bat
tagline: Reliable training bat with bold pick-up and strong edges.
shortDescription: Durable Kashmir willow bat ideal for practice nets and weekend games.
description: PowerDrive blends long-lasting Kashmir willow with a forgiving sweet spot, making it a dependable option for schools, academies, and new hard-ball players. The profile is built to deliver confidence on drives and pulls without feeling heavy.

name: Impact Pro Batting Gloves
tagline: Multi-section protection with lightweight airflow comfort.
shortDescription: Premium batting gloves with split-finger flexibility and soft lining.
description: Impact Pro gloves are designed for long innings and faster hands. Reinforced finger chambers, cushioned palms, and breathable mesh panels help reduce fatigue while giving players a secure, high-grip feel through every shot.

name: Keeper Shield Wicket Gloves
tagline: Sharp grip and responsive catching support behind the stumps.
shortDescription: Match-ready wicket-keeping gloves with deep cups and supple leather palms.
description: Keeper Shield is built for quick takes, close-in standing, and dependable comfort over long sessions. The palm grip pattern is tuned for ball control while the inner lining stays soft and flexible throughout the innings.

specifications.label: Palm
specifications.value: Octopus grip rubber with leather base

name: Club Series Cricket Kit
tagline: An all-in-one starter bundle for serious training sessions.
shortDescription: Complete cricket kit with bat, pads, gloves, thigh guard, and duffle.
description: The Club Series kit gives players a ready-to-play setup in one premium bundle. It is curated for academy and club cricketers who want matching gear, dependable comfort, and a sleek duffle that keeps everything organized on the move.

specifications.label: Included
specifications.value: Bat, gloves, pads, guards, duffle bag

name: Tour Edition Premium Kit
tagline: Premium bundle with elite-grade protective gear and travel bag.
shortDescription: High-end cricket kit curated for competitive players and touring squads.
description: Tour Edition combines premium-grade batting gear with advanced protection and a pro-level travel duffle. It is designed for players who want a polished setup with coordinated, match-ready equipment that performs across formats.
